```artifact
Feature: Lab Management and Patient Services

  Scenario: Lab In-charge viewing and updating lab requests
  Given the lab system is offline
  When the Lab In-charge views open lab requests
  Then they should be able to update the status

  Examples:
    | Status  | Expected Outcome |
    | Open    | Update to Closed |
    | Closed  | No change         |

  Scenario: Patient viewing prescription and invoice
  Given the system is offline
  When the Patient views the prescription
  Then they should be able to print the invoice

  Examples:
    | Prescription Status | Expected Outcome |
    | Available           | Print Invoice     |
    | Unavailable         | Print Invoice     |

  Scenario: Admin printing and emailing prescription and invoice
  Given the system is offline
  When the Admin prints the prescription
  Then they should be able to email the invoice

  Examples:
    | Prescription Status | Expected Outcome |
    | Available           | Email Invoice     |
    | Unavailable         | Email Invoice     |

  Scenario: Archiving patient profiles and consultation requests
  Given the system is offline
  When the system archives profiles and requests
  Then it should follow the 3-year rule

  Examples:
    | Request Age | Expected Outcome |
    | < 3 years           | Not Archived      |
    | > 3 years           | Archived          |

  Scenario: Archiving consultation requests
  Given the system is offline
  When the system archives requests
  Then it should follow the 3-year rule

  Examples:
    | Request Age | Expected Outcome |
    | < 3 years           | Not Archived      |
    | > 3 years           | Archived          |

```json

  {"id": "TC-001", "title": "Lab In-charge updates open lab requests", "req_ids": ["Req-10"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["Lab system is offline"], "inputs": {"status": "Open"}, "steps": ["View open lab requests", "Update status to Closed"], "expected": ["Lab request status updated to Closed"]},
  {"id": "TC-002", "title": "Patient prints prescription and invoice", "req_ids": ["Req-11"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["System is offline"], "inputs": {"prescription status": "Available"}, "steps": ["Print prescription", "Print invoice"], "expected": ["Prescription and invoice printed"]},
  {"id": "TC-003", "title": "Admin prints and emails prescription and invoice", "req_ids": ["Req-11"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["System is offline"], "inputs": {"prescription status": "Available"}, "steps": ["Print prescription", "Email invoice"], "expected": ["Prescription and invoice printed and emailed"]},
  {"id": "TC-004", "title": "Archiving patient profiles and consultation requests", "req_ids": ["Req-12"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["System is offline"], "inputs": {"request age": "> 3 years"}, "steps": ["Archive profiles and requests"], "expected": ["Profiles and requests archived"]},
  {"id": "TC-005", "title": "Archiving consultation requests", "req_ids": ["Req-12"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["System is offline"], "inputs": {"request age": "> 3 years"}, "steps": ["Archive requests"], "expected": ["Requests archived"]}
]
